title: Scheduler: overview
description: Every layer of the scheduler, from the HTTP edge to the database: traffic, latency, error rate with sub-classification, and where the time goes.

panels.title: Overview: the numbers to read first
Requests
panels.description: Requests the edge served in the selected range.

panels.title: Success (2xx/3xx)
panels.description: Share of requests answered 2xx or 3xx. Expected 4xx rejections count against this, so it is informational and not coloured as a failure. The failure SLO is in the 5xx rate and the SLO row.

panels.title: 5xx rate
panels.description: Share of requests that were our failure. Expected 4xx outcomes are not errors.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile of edge duration across the selected operations.

panels.title: Conflicts
panels.description: Share of booking attempts that found the slot already taken. A high value means clients act on stale availability.

panels.title: Bookings
panels.description: Confirmed bookings in the selected range.

panels.title: SLO: availability and error budget (99.5% of requests not 5xx, 30 days)
Availability (30d)
panels.description: Share of requests that were not our failure, over 30 days. Target 99.5%.

panels.title: Error budget left (30d)
panels.description: Share of the 30-day error budget still unspent. Below 0 means the target is missed.

panels.title: Burn rate (1h)
panels.description: How fast the budget is being spent in the last hour. 1 is on track; 14.4 exhausts it in two days.

panels.title: Burn rate (6h)
panels.description: Burn rate over six hours. Slower and steadier than the one-hour figure.

panels.title: Burn rate over time (1h window)
panels.description: Burn rate, with 1 as on track and 14.4 as the fast-burn alert threshold.

panels.title: API rate by operation
panels.description: Requests per second, per generated operation.

panels.title: Outcome rate
panels.description: Requests per second by outcome. The error series is our failure.

panels.title: Booking funnel: from looking at slots to a confirmed booking
Funnel, selected range
panels.description: How many requests reach each stage. Availability views come before booking attempts; conflicts and rejections are the leakage.

panels.title: Conversion
panels.description: Confirmed bookings per availability view in the selected range: how many people who look at slots end up booking.

panels.title: Refused
panels.description: Share of booking attempts that were refused (conflict or rule violation).

panels.title: Booking attempts over time
panels.description: Attempts per second, split by outcome.

panels.title: Latency: how long callers wait (edge, per operation)
p50 latency by operation
panels.description: 50th percentile of edge duration per operation.

panels.title: p95 latency by operation
panels.description: 95th percentile of edge duration per operation.

panels.title: p99 latency by operation
panels.description: 99th percentile of edge duration per operation.

panels.title: Errors: our failures, and the expected outcomes classified
Our failures (5xx) by operation
panels.description: Should stay at zero. Any line here needs a look.

panels.title: Expected outcomes by error code
panels.description: Every 4xx rejection, by its stable error code. Not errors, but the mix shows what clients hit.

panels.title: Rejections in range, by operation and code
panels.description: Counts over the selected range, for triage.

panels.title: Our failures by layer and Postgres class
panels.description: Failures inside the controller and repository, by SQLSTATE class (deadlock, exclusion_violation, ...). Empty on a healthy stack.

panels.title: Layers: the same request, seen at each layer
Operations per second, by layer
panels.description: Each request is counted once per layer it passes through.

panels.title: p95 latency, by layer
panels.description: The gap between the edge and the controller is HTTP and tenant work. The gap to the repository is controller logic.

panels.title: Database operations per second
panels.description: Queries by operation.

panels.title: Database p95 latency by operation
panels.description: Latency per query.

panels.title: Time breakdown: where the time goes
Where the time goes
panels.description: Share of time in the selected range, split without double counting: database, controller logic and HTTP overhead. Nested layers are subtracted from their parents.

panels.title: Database time by query
panels.description: Which queries the database spends its time on.

panels.title: Edge time by operation
panels.description: Total edge time per operation, including the layers under it.

panels.title: Rate limit rejections by scope
panels.description: 429 responses per second: global vs API limits

panels.title: Rate limit rejection rate
panels.description: Share of requests rejected (429)

panels.title: Rate limit rejections in range
panels.description: 429 responses by operation.

panels.title: Tenant drill-down (from logs): pick a tenant above
Requests by operation for this tenant
panels.description: Edge requests per second for the chosen tenant, by operation.

panels.title: Rejections for this tenant, by error code
panels.description: 4xx outcomes for the chosen tenant, by stable error code.

panels.title: Recent log lines for this tenant
panels.description: The raw log, newest first. Each line carries its request and trace id, so it links to the trace in Tempo.
